============================================================================\n\nconstexpr size_t MAX_OCTREE_TRIS = 8;\nconstexpr val_t MAX_OCTREE_LEAF_SIZE = 0.5f;\nconstexpr int OCTREE_STACK = 64;   // traversal stack entries per thread\n\nclass Octree {\npublic:\n    Vec3 minBound, maxBound;\n    Vec3 halfExtent, center;\n    std::unique_ptr<Octree> children[8];\n    std::vector<size_t> triangleIndices;  // Indices into the global triangle list\n    const std::vector<Triangle>* allTriangles;  // Pointer to all triangles\n\n    Octree() : allTriangles(nullptr) {}\n\n    void build(const std::vector<Triangle>& triangles) {\n        allTriangles = &triangles;\n        if (triangles.empty()) return;\n\n        // Compute bounding box\n        minBound = triangles[0].a;\n        maxBound = triangles[0].a;\n        for (const auto& tri : triangles) {\n            for (const auto* v : {&tri.a, &tri.b, &tri.c}) {\n                minBound.x = std::min(minBound.x, v->x);\n                minBound.y = std::min(minBound.y, v->y);\n                minBound.z = std::min(minBound.z, v->z);\n                maxBound.x = std::max(maxBound.x, v->x);\n                maxBound.y = std::max(maxBound.y, v->y);\n                maxBound.z = std::max(maxBound.z, v->z);\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Collect all indices\n        std::vector<size_t> allIndices(triangles.size());\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < triangles.size(); ++i) allIndices[i] = i;\n\n        buildNode(allIndices, minBound, maxBound);\n    }\n\n    // Flatten into GPU-friendly arrays (depth-first). Returns the node id.\n    //   box0[n] = (center.xyz, halfExtent.x), box1[n] = (halfExtent.y, halfExtent.z, -, -)\n    //   meta[3n] = (triStart, triCount, child0, child1), meta[3n+1] = (child2..5),\n    //   meta[3n+2] = (child6, child7, -, -). A node is a leaf iff triCount > 0.\n    int flatten(std::vector<float4>& box0, std::vector<float4>& box1, std::vector<int4>& meta,\n                std::vector<int>& leafTris, int depth, int& maxDepth) const {\n        const int id = static_cast<int>(box0.size());\n        box0.push_back(make_float4(center.x, center.y, center.z, halfExtent.x));\n        box1.push_back(make_float4(halfExtent.y, halfExtent.z, 0.0f, 0.0f));\n        meta.push_back(make_int4(0, 0, -1, -1));\n        meta.push_back(make_int4(-1, -1, -1, -1));\n        meta.push_back(make_int4(-1, -1, 0, 0));\n        maxDepth = std::max(maxDepth, depth);\n\n        if (!triangleIndices.empty()) {\n            const int start = static_cast<int>(leafTris.size());\n            for (size_t idx : triangleIndices) leafTris.push_back(static_cast<int>(idx));\n            meta[3 * id] = make_int4(start, static_cast<int>(triangleIndices.size()), -1, -1);\n        } else {\n            int ch[8];\n            for (int c = 0; c < 8; ++c) {\n                ch[c] = children[c] ? children[c]->flatten(box0, box1, meta, leafTris, depth + 1, maxDepth) : -1;\n            }\n            meta[3 * id] = make_int4(0, 0, ch[0], ch[1]);\n            meta[3 * id + 1] = make_int4(ch[2], ch[3], ch[4], ch[5]);\n            meta[3 * id + 2] = make_int4(ch[6], ch[7], 0, 0);\n        }\n        return id;\n    }\n\nprivate:\n    void buildNode(const std::vector<size_t>& indices, const Vec3& nodeMin, const Vec3& nodeMax) {\n        minBound = nodeMin;\n        maxBound = nodeMax;\n        halfExtent = (maxBound - minBound) * 0.5f;\n        center = (minBound + maxBound) * 0.5f;\n\n        // If few enough triangles or too small, make this a leaf\n        if (indices.size() <= MAX_OCTREE_TRIS ||\n            (maxBound - minBound).norm() < MAX_OCTREE_LEAF_SIZE) {\n            triangleIndices = indices;\n            return;\n        }\n\n        // Subdivide into 8 children\n        Vec3 childHalfSize = halfExtent * 0.5f;\n        std::vector<size_t> childIndices[8];\n\n        for (size_t idx : indices) {\n            const Triangle& tri = (*allTriangles)[idx];\n\n            // Check which children this triangle overlaps\n            for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {\n                Vec3 childCenter = center;\n                childCenter.x += (i & 1) ? childHalfSize.x : -childHalfSize.x;\n                childCenter.y += (i & 2) ? childHalfSize.y : -childHalfSize.y;\n                childCenter.z += (i & 4) ? childHalfSize.z : -childHalfSize.z;\n\n                if (triangleBoxOverlap(childCenter, childHalfSize, tri)) {\n                    childIndices[i].push_back(idx);\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Check if we can't split further (all triangles in one child)\n        bool canSplit = false;\n        for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {\n            if (!childIndices[i].empty() && childIndices[i].size() < indices.size()) {\n                canSplit = true;\n                break;\n            }\n        }\n\n        if (!canSplit) {\n            triangleIndices = indices;\n            return;\n        }\n\n        // Build children\n        for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {\n            if (!childIndices[i].empty()) {\n                Vec3 childMin = center;\n                Vec3 childMax = center;\n                childMin.x = (i & 1) ? center.x : minBound.x;\n                childMax.x = (i & 1) ? maxBound.x : center.x;\n                childMin.y = (i & 2) ? center.y : minBound.y;\n                childMax.y = (i & 2) ? maxBound.y : center.y;\n                childMin.z = (i & 4) ? center.z : minBound.z;\n                childMax.z = (i & 4) ? maxBound.z : center.z;\n\n                children[i] = std::make_unique<Octree>();\n                children[i]->allTriangles = allTriangles;\n                children[i]->buildNode(childIndices[i], childMin, childMax);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n};\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Mesh Generation: Icosphere\n// ============================================================================\n\n// Generate an icosphere by subdividing an icosahedron\nclass IcosphereMesh {\npublic:\n    std::vector<Triangle> triangles;\n\n    IcosphereMesh(int subdivisions, val_t radius) {\n        // Initial icosahedron vertices\n        const val_t t = (1.0f + std::sqrt(5.0f)) / 2.0f;\n\n        std::vector<Vec3> vertices = {\n            Vec3(-1,  t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 1,  t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3(-1, -t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 1, -t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 0, -1,  t).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 0,  1,  t).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 0, -1, -t).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 0,  1, -t).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( t,  0, -1).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( t,  0,  1).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3(-t,  0, -1).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3(-t,  0,  1).normalized() * radius\n        };\n\n        // Initial icosahedron faces (20 triangles)\n        std::vector<std::array<idx_t, 3>> faces = {\n            {0, 11, 5}, {0, 5, 1}, {0, 1, 7}, {0, 7, 10}, {0, 10, 11},\n            {1, 5, 9}, {5, 11, 4}, {11, 10, 2}, {10, 7, 6}, {7, 1, 8},\n            {3, 9, 4}, {3, 4, 2}, {3, 2, 6}, {3, 6, 8}, {3, 8, 9},\n            {4, 9, 5}, {2, 4, 11}, {6, 2, 10}, {8, 6, 7}, {9, 8, 1}\n        };\n\n        // Subdivide\n        for (int i = 0; i < subdivisions; ++i) {\n            std::vector<std::array<idx_t, 3>> newFaces;\n            std::map<std::pair<idx_t, idx_t>, idx_t> midpointCache;\n\n            auto getMidpoint = [&](idx_t i1, idx_t i2) -> idx_t {\n                auto key = std::make_pair(std::min(i1, i2), std::max(i1, i2));\n                auto it = midpointCache.find(key);\n                if (it != midpointCache.end()) return it->second;\n\n                Vec3 mid = (vertices[i1] + vertices[i2]) / 2.0f;\n                mid = mid.normalized() * radius;\n                idx_t idx = static_cast<idx_t>(vertices.size());\n                vertices.push_back(mid);\n                midpointCache[key] = idx;\n                return idx;\n            };\n\n            for (const auto& face : faces) {\n                idx_t a = getMidpoint(face[0], face[1]);\n                idx_t b = getMidpoint(face[1], face[2]);\n                idx_t c = getMidpoint(face[2], face[0]);\n\n                newFaces.push_back({face[0], a, c});\n                newFaces.push_back({face[1], b, a});\n                newFaces.push_back({face[2], c, b});\n                newFaces.push_back({a, b, c});\n            }\n            faces = std::move(newFaces);\n        }\n\n        // Build triangles (normals pointing inward for a \"room\")\n        triangles.reserve(faces.size());\n        for (const auto& face : faces) {\n            // Reverse winding to make normals point inward\n            triangles.emplace_back(vertices[face[2]], vertices[face[1]], vertices[face[0]]);\n        }\n    }\n};\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Random Number Generation: bit-exact MT19937 stream replication on the GPU\n// ============================================================================\n//\n// The sequential implementation draws from one std::mt19937(42) through\n// std::uniform_real_distribution<float>(0,1); each sample is\n// float(u32) * 2^-32 (clamped below 1). Every visible pair consumes exactly\n// 4 * NUM_RAYS draws, so the stream position of every draw is known. The\n// stream is split into sub-streams whose start states are obtained by\n// jump-ahead: state(n + J) = g_J(A) state(n) with g_J = x^J mod q(x), where q\n// is the minimal polynomial of the MT19937 state transition.\n\nnamespace mt {\n\nconstexpr int N = 624;\nconstexpr int M = 397;\nconstexpr uint32_t MATRIX_A = 0x9908b0dfu;\nconstexpr uint32_t UPPER_MASK = 0x80000000u;\nconstexpr uint32_t LOWER_MASK = 0x7fffffffu;\nconstexpr int THREADS = 256;          // block size of MT kernels (>= 227 required)\nconstexpr int POLY_WORDS = 624;       // 32-bit words per jump polynomial (19968 bits >= deg q)\nconstexpr int SEQ_BLOCKS = 33;        // state blocks of history a jump needs (>= (POLY_WORDS*32 + N - 1) / N)\nconstexpr int SEQ_LEN = SEQ_BLOCKS * N;\nconstexpr int MAX_STREAMS = 2048;     // maximum number of parallel sub-streams\nconstexpr int MIN_BLOCKS_PER_STREAM = 16;\nconstexpr uint64_t BUFFER_BUDGET = 256ull << 20;   // random values resident on the GPU at once\n\n__host__ __device__ __forceinline__ uint32_t mix(uint32_t a, uint32_t b, uint32_t c) {\n    uint32_t y = (a & UPPER_MASK) | (b & LOWER_MASK);\n    return c ^ (y >> 1) ^ ((y & 1u) ? MATRIX_A : 0u);\n}\n\n__host__ __device__ __forceinline__ uint32_t temper(uint32_t y) {\n    y ^= y >> 11;\n    y ^= (y << 7) & 0x9d2c5680u;\n    y ^= (y << 15) & 0xefc60000u;\n    y ^= y >> 18;\n    return y;\n}\n\n// std::generate_canonical<float, 24>(mt19937) followed by uniform_real_distribution(0,1)\n__host__ __device__ __forceinline__ float toUniform(uint32_t y) {\n    float f = static_cast<float>(y) * 2.3283064365386962890625e-10f;   // * 2^-32\n    if (f >= 1.0f) f = 0.99999994f;   // nextafter(1, 0)\n    return f;\n}\n\ninline void seedState(uint32_t* s, uint32_t seed) {\n    s[0] = seed;\n    for (int i = 1; i < N; ++i) s[i] = 1812433253u * (s[i - 1] ^ (s[i - 1] >> 30)) + static_cast<uint32_t>(i);\n}\n\ninline void twistHost(uint32_t* s) {\n    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) s[i] = mix(s[i], s[(i + 1) % N], s[(i + M) % N]);\n}\n\n// Block-cooperative in-place twist of a 624-word state held in shared memory.\n// The sequential recurrence is split into three dependency-free phases.\n__device__ __forceinline__ void twistBlock(uint32_t* s) {\n    const int tid = threadIdx.x;\n    uint32_t v = 0;\n    // Phase 1: i in [0, 227): reads only old values\n    if (tid < N - M) v = mix(s[tid], s[tid + 1], s[tid + M]);\n    __syncthreads();\n    if (tid < N - M) s[tid] = v;\n    __syncthreads();\n    // Phase 2: i in [227, 454): reads new values from phase 1\n    if (tid < N - M) { int i = (N - M) + tid; v = mix(s[i], s[i + 1], s[i - (N - M)]); }\n    __syncthreads();\n    if (tid < N - M) s[(N - M) + tid] = v;\n    __syncthreads();\n    // Phase 3: i in [454, 624): reads new values from phases 1 and 2\n    if (tid < N - 2 * (N - M)) { int i = 2 * (N - M) + tid; v = mix(s[i], s[(i + 1) % N], s[i - (N - M)]); }\n    __syncthreads();\n    if (tid < N - 2 * (N - M)) s[2 * (N - M) + tid] = v;\n    __syncthreads();\n}\n\n// dst[b] = jump(src[b]) for block b: dst[w] = sum_k poly_k * seq_src[k + w]\n__global__ void __launch_bounds__(THREADS)\njumpKernel(const uint32_t* __restrict__ src, uint32_t* __restrict__ dst,\n           const uint32_t* __restrict__ poly, uint32_t* __restrict__ scratch) {\n    __shared__ uint32_t s[N];\n    const int tid = threadIdx.x;\n    const uint32_t* in = src + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * N;\n    uint32_t* seq = scratch + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * SEQ_LEN;\n\n    for (int w = tid; w < N; w += THREADS) s[w] = in[w];\n    __syncthreads();\n    for (int b = 0; b < SEQ_BLOCKS; ++b) {\n        for (int w = tid; w < N; w += THREADS) seq[b * N + w] = s[w];\n        twistBlock(s);\n    }\n    __syncthreads();\n\n    const int w0 = tid, w1 = tid + THREADS, w2 = tid + 2 * THREADS;\n    uint32_t acc0 = 0, acc1 = 0, acc2 = 0;\n    for (int kw = 0; kw < POLY_WORDS; ++kw) {\n        const uint32_t bits = __ldg(poly + kw);\n        if (bits == 0) continue;\n        const int kbase = kw * 32;\n#pragma unroll 8\n        for (int b = 0; b < 32; ++b) {\n            if ((bits >> b) & 1u) {\n                const int k = kbase + b;\n                acc0 ^= seq[k + w0];\n                acc1 ^= seq[k + w1];\n                if (w2 < N) acc2 ^= seq[k + w2];\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    uint32_t* out = dst + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * N;\n    out[w0] = acc0;\n    out[w1] = acc1;\n    if (w2 < N) out[w2] = acc2;\n}\n\n// Advance a single state by `twists` full state updates\n__global__ void __launch_bounds__(THREADS)\nadvanceKernel(const uint32_t* __restrict__ src, uint32_t* __restrict__ dst, int twists) {\n    __shared__ uint32_t s[N];\n    for (int w = threadIdx.x; w < N; w += THREADS) s[w] = src[w];\n    __syncthreads();\n    for (int t = 0; t < twists; ++t) twistBlock(s);\n    for (int w = threadIdx.x; w < N; w += THREADS) dst[w] = s[w];\n}\n\n// Each block generates sub-stream s: outputs for positions\n// [A + s*L, A + (s+1)*L), storing those in [g, g + count) to buf[pos - g].\n// The state after the sub-stream is written to endStates.\n__global__ void __launch_bounds__(THREADS)\ngenerateKernel(const uint32_t* __restrict__ states, uint32_t* __restrict__ endStates,\n               int blocksPerStream, uint64_t A, uint64_t g, uint64_t count,\n               float* __restrict__ buf) {\n    __shared__ uint32_t s[N];\n    const int tid = threadIdx.x;\n    const size_t sid = blockIdx.x;\n    for (int w = tid; w < N; w += THREADS) s[w] = states[sid * N + w];\n    __syncthreads();\n\n    const uint64_t pos0 = A + sid * static_cast<uint64_t>(blocksPerStream) * N;\n    const uint64_t end = g + count;\n    for (int b = 0; b < blocksPerStream; ++b) {\n        const uint64_t base = pos0 + static_cast<uint64_t>(b) * N;\n        if (base + N > g && base < end) {\n            for (int w = tid; w < N; w += THREADS) {\n                const uint64_t pos = base + w;\n                if (pos >= g && pos < end) buf[pos - g] = toUniform(temper(s[w]));\n            }\n        }\n        twistBlock(s);\n    }\n    for (int w = tid; w < N; w += THREADS) endStates[sid * N + w] = s[w];\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// GF(2) polynomial arithmetic (host) for computing jump polynomials\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\nstruct GF2Poly {\n    std::vector<uint64_t> w;\n    GF2Poly() = default;\n    explicit GF2Poly(size_t words) : w(words, 0) {}\n    bool bit(size_t i) const { return (w[i >> 6] >> (i & 63)) & 1u; }\n    int degree() const {\n        for (size_t i = w.size(); i-- > 0;) {\n            if (w[i]) return static_cast<int>(i * 64 + 63 - __builtin_clzll(w[i]));\n        }\n        return -1;\n    }\n};\n\n// dst ^= src << shift, using src words [0, srcWords)\nstatic void xorShifted(GF2Poly& dst, const GF2Poly& src, size_t shift, size_t srcWords) {\n    const size_t ws = shift >> 6, bs = shift & 63;\n    const size_t n = dst.w.size();\n    if (bs == 0) {\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < srcWords && i + ws < n; ++i) dst.w[i + ws] ^= src.w[i];\n        return;\n    }\n    uint64_t carry = 0;\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < srcWords && i + ws < n; ++i) {\n        const uint64_t v = src.w[i];\n        dst.w[i + ws] ^= (v << bs) | carry;\n        carry = v >> (64 - bs);\n    }\n    if (srcWords + ws < n) dst.w[srcWords + ws] ^= carry;\n}\n\n// Berlekamp-Massey over GF(2): minimal polynomial of the bit sequence s.\nstatic GF2Poly berlekampMassey(const std::vector<uint8_t>& s, int& Lout) {\n    const size_t n = s.size();\n    const size_t words = n / 64 + 2;\n    GF2Poly C(words), B(words), T(words), R(words);\n    C.w[0] = 1;\n    B.w[0] = 1;\n    int L = 0;\n    size_t m = 1;\n    for (size_t k = 0; k < n; ++k) {\n        // R = (R << 1) | s[k]  =>  bit i of R is s[k - i]\n        const size_t top = k / 64 + 1;\n        for (size_t i = top; i >= 1; --i) R.w[i] = (R.w[i] << 1) | (R.w[i - 1] >> 63);\n        R.w[0] = (R.w[0] << 1) | s[k];\n        // discrepancy d = sum_{i<=L} C_i s[k-i]\n        uint64_t acc = 0;\n        const size_t cw = static_cast<size_t>(L) / 64 + 1;\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < cw; ++i) acc ^= C.w[i] & R.w[i];\n        if (__builtin_parityll(acc) == 0) { ++m; continue; }\n        if (2 * L <= static_cast<int>(k)) {\n            T = C;\n            xorShifted(C, B, m, words);\n            L = static_cast<int>(k) + 1 - L;\n            B = T;\n            m = 1;\n        } else {\n            xorShifted(C, B, m, words);\n            ++m;\n        }\n    }\n    Lout = L;\n    return C;\n}\n\n// Arithmetic modulo q(x), with byte-wise table reduction.\nstruct JumpPolyCalc {\n    int D;               // degree of q\n    size_t words;        // words per working polynomial (holds degree < 2D)\n    size_t tabWords;     // words per table entry (degree <= D + 7)\n    GF2Poly q;\n    std::vector<GF2Poly> tab;   // tab[b]: multiple of q with bit pattern b at [D, D+8), zero above\n    uint16_t spread8[256];\n\n    JumpPolyCalc(const GF2Poly& qIn, int Din)\n        : D(Din), words(2 * static_cast<size_t>(Din) / 64 + 2), tabWords((static_cast<size_t>(Din) + 8) / 64 + 1),\n          q(words), tab(256, GF2Poly(words)) {\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < qIn.w.size() && i < words; ++i) q.w[i] = qIn.w[i];\n        GF2Poly e[8];\n        e[0] = q;\n        for (int j = 0; j < 7; ++j) {\n            e[j + 1] = GF2Poly(words);\n            xorShifted(e[j + 1], e[j], 1, tabWords);\n            for (int i = j; i >= 0; --i) {\n                if (e[j + 1].bit(D + i)) {\n                    for (size_t w = 0; w < tabWords; ++w) e[j + 1].w[w] ^= e[i].w[w];\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        for (int b = 1; b < 256; ++b) {\n            const int low = __builtin_ctz(b);\n            tab[b] = tab[b & (b - 1)];\n            for (size_t w = 0; w < tabWords; ++w) tab[b].w[w] ^= e[low].w[w];\n        }\n        for (int b = 0; b < 256; ++b) {\n            uint16_t v = 0;\n            for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) if ((b >> i) & 1) v |= static_cast<uint16_t>(1u << (2 * i));\n            spread8[b] = v;\n        }\n    }\n\n    void reduce(GF2Poly& p) const {\n        const int deg = p.degree();\n        if (deg < D) return;\n        for (long pos = D + 8 * ((deg - D) / 8); pos >= D; pos -= 8) {\n            const size_t wi = static_cast<size_t>(pos) >> 6, bi = static_cast<size_t>(pos) & 63;\n            uint64_t v = p.w[wi] >> bi;\n            if (bi > 56 && wi + 1 < p.w.size()) v |= p.w[wi + 1] << (64 - bi);\n            const unsigned byte = static_cast<unsigned>(v & 0xFFu);\n            if (byte) xorShifted(p, tab[byte], static_cast<size_t>(pos - D), tabWords);\n        }\n    }\n\n    uint64_t spread32(uint32_t v) const {\n        return static_cast<uint64_t>(spread8[v & 0xFF]) |\n               (static_cast<uint64_t>(spread8[(v >> 8) & 0xFF]) << 16) |\n               (static_cast<uint64_t>(spread8[(v >> 16) & 0xFF]) << 32) |\n               (static_cast<uint64_t>(spread8[(v >> 24) & 0xFF]) << 48);\n    }\n\n    void square(GF2Poly& p) const {\n        GF2Poly r(words);\n        const size_t inWords = static_cast<size_t>(D) / 64 + 1;\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < inWords; ++i) {\n            const uint64_t v = p.w[i];\n            r.w[2 * i] = spread32(static_cast<uint32_t>(v));\n            r.w[2 * i + 1] = spread32(static_cast<uint32_t>(v >> 32));\n        }\n        reduce(r);\n        p = std::move(r);\n    }\n\n    void mulx(GF2Poly& p) const {\n        uint64_t carry = 0;\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < words; ++i) {\n            const uint64_t v = p.w[i];\n            p.w[i] = (v << 1) | carry;\n            carry = v >> 63;\n        }\n        if (p.bit(D)) {\n            for (size_t i = 0; i < words; ++i) p.w[i] ^= q.w[i];\n        }\n    }\n\n    // x^e mod q\n    GF2Poly powx(uint64_t e) const {\n        GF2Poly r(words);\n        r.w[0] = 1;\n        if (e == 0) return r;\n        for (int b = 63 - __builtin_clzll(e); b >= 0; --b) {\n            square(r);\n            if ((e >> b) & 1u) mulx(r);\n        }\n        return r;\n    }\n};\n\n// Minimal polynomial q(x) of the MT19937 state transition (q = x * p(x) where p is the\n// characteristic polynomial of the 19937-bit recurrence; the factor x accounts for the\n// 31 unused low bits of state word 0).\nstatic GF2Poly transitionPolynomial(int& D) {\n    constexpr int DEG = 19938;\n    std::vector<uint8_t> seq(2 * DEG + 128);\n    std::mt19937 rng(42);\n    for (auto& b : seq) b = static_cast<uint8_t>(rng() & 1u);\n    int L = 0;\n    GF2Poly C = berlekampMassey(seq, L);\n    if (L < DEG - 1 || L > DEG || C.degree() != L) {\n        fprintf(stderr, \"Failed to recover the MT19937 minimal polynomial (degree %d)\\n\", L);\n        exit(1);\n    }\n    if (C.bit(0)) {   // multiply by x\n        GF2Poly q(C.w.size());\n        xorShifted(q, C, 1, C.w.size() - 1);\n        D = L + 1;\n        return q;\n    }\n    D = L;\n    return C;\n}\n\n}  // namespace mt\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Ray-Triangle Intersection (Möller-Trumbore algorithm)\n// ============================================================================\n\n__host__ __device__ __forceinline__\nval_t rayTriangleIntersect(const Vec3& orig, const Vec3& dir,\n                           const Vec3& v0, const Vec3& v1, const Vec3& v2) {\n    Vec3 e1 = v1 - v0;\n    Vec3 e2 = v2 - v0;\n    Vec3 pvec = dir.cross(e2);\n    val_t det = e1.dot(pvec);\n\n    if (fabsf(det) < EPSILON) return VAL_MAX;\n\n    val_t invDet = 1.0f / det;\n    Vec3 tvec = orig - v0;\n    val_t u = tvec.dot(pvec) * invDet;\n    if (u < 0.0f || u > 1.0f) return VAL_MAX;\n\n    Vec3 qvec = tvec.cross(e1);\n    val_t v = dir.dot(qvec) * invDet;\n    if (v < 0.0f || u + v > 1.0f) return VAL_MAX;\n\n    return e2.dot(qvec) * invDet;\n}\n\n// Generate a point inside a triangle using barycentric coordinates from two uniform samples\n__host__ __device__ __forceinline__\nVec3 randomPointInTriangle(const Vec3& a, const Vec3& b, const Vec3& c, val_t u, val_t v) {\n    if (u + v > 1.0f) {\n        u = 1.0f - u;\n        v = 1.0f - v;\n    }\n    Vec3 ab = b - a;\n    Vec3 ac = c - a;\n    return a + ab * u + ac * v;\n}\n\n// Compute the cosine of angle between vector and triangle normal\n__host__ __device__ __forceinline__\nval_t cosPhi(const Vec3& v, const Vec3& normal) {\n    val_t vNorm = v.norm();\n    if (vNorm <= EPSILON) return ZERO;\n    return vmax(ZERO, v.dot(normal) / vNorm);\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Visibility Testing (Octree-accelerated, device)\n// ============================================================================\n\n// Check if a ray between two triangles is blocked by any other triangle\n__device__ bool isRayBlocked(const Vec3& from, const Vec3& to, int srcTriIdx, int dstTriIdx,\n                             const float4* __restrict__ box0, const float4* __restrict__ box1,\n                             const int4* __restrict__ meta, const int* __restrict__ leafTris,\n                             const float4* __restrict__ triA, const float4* __restrict__ triB,\n                             const float4* __restrict__ triC) {\n    Vec3 dir = to - from;\n    val_t rayLen = dir.norm();\n    if (rayLen < EPSILON) return true;\n    Vec3 dirNorm = dir / rayLen;\n\n    // Ray/box separating-axis quantities (see Octree::rayIntersectsBox)\n    Vec3 d = dir * 0.5f;\n    Vec3 mid = from + d;\n    Vec3 ad(fabsf(d.x), fabsf(d.y), fabsf(d.z));\n\n    int stack[OCTREE_STACK];\n    int sp = 0;\n    stack[sp++] = 0;\n\n    while (sp > 0) {\n        const int n = stack[--sp];\n        const int4 m0 = __ldg(meta + 3 * n);\n        if (m0.y > 0) {\n            // Leaf: test triangles\n            for (int k = 0; k < m0.y; ++k) {\n                const int idx = __ldg(leafTris + m0.x + k);\n                if (idx == srcTriIdx || idx == dstTriIdx) continue;\n                const float4 a = __ldg(triA + idx);\n                const float4 b = __ldg(triB + idx);\n                const float4 c = __ldg(triC + idx);\n                val_t dist = rayTriangleIntersect(from, dirNorm, toVec3(a), toVec3(b), toVec3(c));\n                if (dist > EPSILON && dist < rayLen - EPSILON) return true;\n            }\n        } else {\n            const int4 m1 = __ldg(meta + 3 * n + 1);\n            const int4 m2 = __ldg(meta + 3 * n + 2);\n            const int ch[8] = {m0.z, m0.w, m1.x, m1.y, m1.z, m1.w, m2.x, m2.y};\n#pragma unroll\n            for (int c = 0; c < 8; ++c) {\n                const int child = ch[c];\n                if (child < 0) continue;\n                const float4 b0 = __ldg(box0 + child);\n                const float4 b1 = __ldg(box1 + child);\n                const val_t hx = b0.w, hy = b1.x, hz = b1.y;\n                Vec3 cc(mid.x - b0.x, mid.y - b0.y, mid.z - b0.z);\n                if (fabsf(cc.x) > hx + ad.x) continue;\n                if (fabsf(cc.y) > hy + ad.y) continue;\n                if (fabsf(cc.z) > hz + ad.z) continue;\n                if (fabsf(d.y * cc.z - d.z * cc.y) > hy * ad.z + hz * ad.y + EPSILON) continue;\n                if (fabsf(d.z * cc.x - d.x * cc.z) > hz * ad.x + hx * ad.z + EPSILON) continue;\n                if (fabsf(d.x * cc.y - d.y * cc.x) > hx * ad.y + hy * ad.x + EPSILON) continue;\n                stack[sp++] = child;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    return false;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Form Factor Computation (Kij) kernel\n// ============================================================================\n\nconstexpr int FF_PAIRS_PER_BLOCK = 16;\nconstexpr int FF_THREADS = FF_PAIRS_PER_BLOCK * NUM_RAYS;   // 256\n\n// One block handles FF_PAIRS_PER_BLOCK consecutive pairs (i, j0..j0+15) of one row,\n// one thread per ray. `flags` marks pairs that consume random numbers (i != j and\n// not culled); the rank of a pair among all flagged pairs gives its position in\n// the random stream (4 * NUM_RAYS values per pair).\n__global__ void __launch_bounds__(FF_THREADS)\nformFactorKernel(int N, int rowStart, int numSeg, uint64_t rankBase,\n                 const uint32_t* __restrict__ flags, int flagStride,\n                 const uint64_t* __restrict__ rowBase,\n                 const int* __restrict__ supPrefix, int supStride,\n                 const float* __restrict__ rnd,\n                 const float4* __restrict__ triA, const float4* __restrict__ triB,\n                 const float4* __restrict__ triC, const float4* __restrict__ triN,\n                 const float4* __restrict__ box0, const float4* __restrict__ box1,\n                 const int4* __restrict__ meta, const int* __restrict__ leafTris,\n                 float* __restrict__ kij) {\n    const int rowOff = blockIdx.x / numSeg;\n    const int i = rowStart + rowOff;\n    const int seg = blockIdx.x - rowOff * numSeg;\n    const int j0 = seg * FF_PAIRS_PER_BLOCK;\n    const int p = threadIdx.x >> 4;        // pair within block\n    const int r = threadIdx.x & 15;        // ray index\n    const int j = j0 + p;\n\n    const uint32_t* frow = flags + static_cast<size_t>(i) * flagStride;\n    const uint32_t word = (frow[j0 >> 5] >> (j0 & 31)) & 0xFFFFu;\n    const bool active = (j < N) && ((word >> p) & 1u);\n\n    // Rank of this pair among flagged pairs of the row\n    int base = supPrefix[static_cast<size_t>(i) * supStride + (j0 >> 10)];\n    const int wStart = (j0 & ~1023) >> 5;\n    const int wEnd = j0 >> 5;\n    for (int w = wStart; w < wEnd; ++w) base += __popc(frow[w]);\n    if (j0 & 31) base += __popc(frow[wEnd] & 0xFFFFu);\n    base += __popc(word & ((1u << p) - 1u));\n    const uint64_t pairRank = rowBase[i] - rankBase + static_cast<uint64_t>(base);\n\n    float term = ZERO;\n    if (active) {\n        const float4 u = *reinterpret_cast<const float4*>(rnd + pairRank * (4 * NUM_RAYS) + r * 4);\n        const Vec3 aI = toVec3(__ldg(triA + i)), bI = toVec3(__ldg(triB + i)), cI = toVec3(__ldg(triC + i));\n        const Vec3 aJ = toVec3(__ldg(triA + j)), bJ = toVec3(__ldg(triB + j)), cJ = toVec3(__ldg(triC + j));\n        const Vec3 nI = toVec3(__ldg(triN + i)), nJ = toVec3(__ldg(triN + j));\n\n        Vec3 pI = randomPointInTriangle(aI, bI, cI, u.x, u.y);\n        Vec3 pJ = randomPointInTriangle(aJ, bJ, cJ, u.z, u.w);\n\n        if (!isRayBlocked(pI, pJ, i, j, box0, box1, meta, leafTris, triA, triB, triC)) {\n            Vec3 v = pJ - pI;\n            val_t distSqr = v.squaredNorm();\n            if (!(distSqr < EPSILON)) {\n                val_t cosPhiI = cosPhi(v, nI);\n                val_t cosPhiJ = cosPhi(-v, nJ);\n                if (!(cosPhiI <= ZERO || cosPhiJ <= ZERO)) {\n                    term = (cosPhiI * cosPhiJ) / (PI * distSqr);\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Accumulate the 16 ray contributions in the original (sequential) order\n    const int groupBase = threadIdx.x & 16;\n    val_t kijSum = ZERO;\n#pragma unroll\n    for (int rr = 0; rr < NUM_RAYS; ++rr) {\n        kijSum += __shfl_sync(0xffffffffu, term, groupBase + rr);\n    }\n    if (r == 0 && active) kij[static_cast<size_t>(i) * N + j] = kijSum * INV_NUM_RAYS;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Tau (time delay) kernel\n// ============================================================================\n\n__global__ void tauKernel(int N, const float4* __restrict__ centers, int* __restrict__ tau) {\n    const size_t idx = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    const size_t total = static_cast<size_t>(N) * N;\n    if (idx >= total) return;\n    const int i = static_cast<int>(idx / N);\n    const int j = static_cast<int>(idx - static_cast<size_t>(i) * N);\n    int t = 0;\n    if (i != j) {\n        Vec3 ci = toVec3(__ldg(centers + i));\n        Vec3 cj = toVec3(__ldg(centers + j));\n        val_t dist = (ci - cj).norm();\n        t = static_cast<int>(ceilf(dist * INV_WAVE_SPEED));\n    }\n    tau[idx] = t;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Wave propagation kernel: one timestep, one warp per receiving triangle\n// ============================================================================\n\nconstexpr int SIM_THREADS = 256;\n\n__global__ void __launch_bounds__(SIM_THREADS)\nsimStepKernel(int t, int N, const float* __restrict__ kij, const int* __restrict__ tau,\n              const float* __restrict__ areas, const float* __restrict__ rho,\n              const float* __restrict__ radE, float* __restrict__ radB) {\n    const int warp = (blockIdx.x * SIM_THREADS + threadIdx.x) >> 5;\n    const int lane = threadIdx.x & 31;\n    if (warp >= N) return;\n    const int i = warp;\n    const float* krow = kij + static_cast<size_t>(i) * N;\n    const int* trow = tau + static_cast<size_t>(i) * N;\n\n    val_t sumB = ZERO;\n    for (int j = lane; j < N; j += 32) {\n        if (j == i) continue;\n        const int tauij = __ldg(trow + j);\n        if (t < tauij) continue;                       // wave hasn't propagated yet\n        const val_t k = __ldg(krow + j);\n        if (k <= ZERO) continue;\n        const val_t radJ = radB[static_cast<size_t>(t - tauij) * N + j];\n        if (radJ <= ZERO) continue;\n        sumB += vmin(k * __ldg(areas + j), ONE) * radJ;\n    }\n#pragma unroll\n    for (int off = 16; off > 0; off >>= 1) sumB += __shfl_xor_sync(0xffffffffu, sumB, off);\n    if (lane == 0) {\n        radB[static_cast<size_t>(t) * N + i] = __ldg(rho + i) * sumB + __ldg(radE + static_cast<size_t>(t) * N + i);\n    }\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Distance (cross-correlation) kernel: one block per triangle, one thread per lag\n// ============================================================================\n\nconstexpr int DIST_THREADS = 256;\n\n__global__ void __launch_bounds__(DIST_THREADS)\ndistanceKernel(int N, int T, int sourceIndex, const float* __restrict__ radB,\n               float* __restrict__ distances) {\n    __shared__ val_t sVal[DIST_THREADS];\n    __shared__ int sT[DIST_THREADS];\n    const int i = blockIdx.x;\n    const int tid = threadIdx.x;\n\n    val_t maxCorr = ZERO;\n    int bestT = 0;\n    for (int t = tid; t < T; t += DIST_THREADS) {\n        val_t sum = ZERO;\n        for (int tt = t; tt < T; ++tt) {\n            val_t pB = radB[static_cast<size_t>(tt) * N + i];\n            val_t pS = radB[static_cast<size_t>(tt - t) * N + sourceIndex];\n            sum += pS * pB;\n        }\n        if (sum > maxCorr) {   // strict: first maximum in increasing t wins\n            maxCorr = sum;\n            bestT = t;\n        }\n    }\n    sVal[tid] = maxCorr;\n    sT[tid] = bestT;\n    __syncthreads();\n    for (int s = DIST_THREADS / 2; s > 0; s >>= 1) {\n        if (tid < s) {\n            const val_t v = sVal[tid + s];\n            const int t2 = sT[tid + s];\n            if (v > sVal[tid] || (v == sVal[tid] && t2 < sT[tid])) {\n                sVal[tid] = v;\n                sT[tid] = t2;\n            }\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n    }\n    if (tid == 0) distances[i] = WAVE_SPEED * static_cast<val_t>(sT[0]);\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Room Response Simulation State\n// ============================================================================\n\nstruct SimulationState {\n    size_t numTriangles;\n    size_t numTimesteps;\n\n    std::vector<Triangle> triangles;\n    std::vector<val_t> areas;       // Area of each triangle\n    std::vector<val_t> rho;         // Reflectivity (0.0 to 1.0)\n    std::vector<val_t> kij;         // Form factors (N x N, row-major) - host copy for validation\n    std::vector<val_t> radE;        // Emission radiosity (T x N matrix)\n    std::vector<val_t> radB;        // Reflected radiosity (T x N matrix) - host copy for validation\n    std::vector<val_t> distances;   // Computed distances from source\n\n    Octree octree;                  // Spatial acceleration structure (host)\n\n    size_t sourceIndex;\n\n    // Device data\n    float4* d_triA = nullptr;\n    float4* d_triB = nullptr;\n    float4* d_triC = nullptr;\n    float4* d_triN = nullptr;\n    float4* d_centers = nullptr;\n    float* d_areas = nullptr;\n    float* d_rho = nullptr;\n    float* d_kij = nullptr;         // N x N\n    int* d_tau = nullptr;           // N x N\n    float* d_radE = nullptr;        // T x N\n    float* d_radB = nullptr;        // T x N\n    float* d_distances = nullptr;   // N\n    float4* d_box0 = nullptr;       // octree nodes\n    float4* d_box1 = nullptr;\n    int4* d_meta = nullptr;\n    int* d_leafTris = nullptr;\n\n    size_t idx2d(size_t i, size_t j) const { return i * numTriangles + j; }\n    size_t idxTN(size_t t, size_t n) const { return t * numTriangles + n; }\n};\n\ntemplate <typename T>\nstatic T* deviceUpload(const std::vector<T>& v) {\n    T* d = nullptr;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d, std::max<size_t>(1, v.size()) * sizeof(T)));\n    if (!v.empty()) CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(d, v.data(), v.size() * sizeof(T), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    return d;\n}\n\nstatic void syncDevice() {\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Initialization\n// ============================================================================\n\nvoid initializeSimulation(SimulationState& state, int subdivisions, size_t timesteps,\n                          size_t sourceIdx, val_t reflectivity) {\n    // Generate mesh\n    IcosphereMesh mesh(subdivisions, 10.0f);  // Radius 10 units\n    state.triangles = std::move(mesh.triangles);\n    state.numTriangles = state.triangles.size();\n    state.numTimesteps = timesteps;\n    state.sourceIndex = sourceIdx % state.numTriangles;\n\n    printf(\"Generated icosphere mesh with %zu triangles\\n\", state.numTriangles);\n\n    // Build octree for spatial acceleration\n    printf(\"Building octree...\\n\");\n    state.octree.build(state.triangles);\n\n    const size_t N = state.numTriangles;\n\n    // Initialize areas\n    state.areas.resize(N);\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n        state.areas[i] = state.triangles[i].area();\n    }\n\n    // Initialize reflectivity\n    state.rho.resize(N, reflectivity);\n\n    // Initialize matrices\n    state.radE.resize(timesteps * N, ZERO);\n    state.distances.resize(N, ZERO);\n\n    // Set source emission (active for first half of timesteps)\n    size_t timeOn = 0;\n    size_t timeOff = timesteps / 2;\n    for (size_t t = timeOn; t < timeOff; ++t) {\n        state.radE[state.idxTN(t, state.sourceIndex)] = 1.0f;\n    }\n\n    // ---- Upload geometry and allocate device matrices ----\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(0));  // create the context now, outside the timed phases\n\n    std::vector<float4> hA(N), hB(N), hC(N), hN(N), hCen(N);\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n        const Triangle& t = state.triangles[i];\n        const Vec3 c = t.center();\n        hA[i] = make_float4(t.a.x, t.a.y, t.a.z, 0.0f);\n        hB[i] = make_float4(t.b.x, t.b.y, t.b.z, 0.0f);\n        hC[i] = make_float4(t.c.x, t.c.y, t.c.z, 0.0f);\n        hN[i] = make_float4(t._normal.x, t._normal.y, t._normal.z, 0.0f);\n        hCen[i] = make_float4(c.x, c.y, c.z, 0.0f);\n    }\n    state.d_triA = deviceUpload(hA);\n    state.d_triB = deviceUpload(hB);\n    state.d_triC = deviceUpload(hC);\n    state.d_triN = deviceUpload(hN);\n    state.d_centers = deviceUpload(hCen);\n    state.d_areas = deviceUpload(state.areas);\n    state.d_rho = deviceUpload(state.rho);\n    state.d_radE = deviceUpload(state.radE);\n\n    std::vector<float4> box0, box1;\n    std::vector<int4> meta;\n    std::vector<int> leafTris;\n    int maxDepth = 0;\n    state.octree.flatten(box0, box1, meta, leafTris, 1, maxDepth);\n    if (maxDepth * 7 + 1 > OCTREE_STACK) {\n        fprintf(stderr, \"Octree too deep for the traversal stack (%d levels)\\n\", maxDepth);\n        exit(1);\n    }\n    state.d_box0 = deviceUpload(box0);\n    state.d_box1 = deviceUpload(box1);\n    state.d_meta = deviceUpload(meta);\n    state.d_leafTris = deviceUpload(leafTris);\n\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&state.d_kij, N * N * sizeof(float)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&state.d_tau, N * N * sizeof(int)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&state.d_radB, timesteps * N * sizeof(float)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&state.d_distances, N * sizeof(float)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(state.d_kij, 0, N * N * sizeof(float)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(state.d_tau, 0, N * N * sizeof(int)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(state.d_radB, 0, timesteps * N * sizeof(float)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(state.d_distances, 0, N * sizeof(float)));\n    syncDevice();\n}\n\nvoid freeDeviceState(SimulationState& state) {\n    cudaFree(state.d_triA); cudaFree(state.d_triB); cudaFree(state.d_triC); cudaFree(state.d_triN);\n    cudaFree(state.d_centers); cudaFree(state.d_areas); cudaFree(state.d_rho);\n    cudaFree(state.d_kij); cudaFree(state.d_tau); cudaFree(state.d_radE); cudaFree(state.d_radB);\n    cudaFree(state.d_distances); cudaFree(state.d_box0); cudaFree(state.d_box1);\n    cudaFree(state.d_meta); cudaFree(state.d_leafTris);\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Precomputation Phase\n// ============================================================================\n\nvoid computeFormFactors(SimulationState& state) {\n    printf(\"Computing form factors (Kij)...\\n\");\n    const size_t N = state.numTriangles;\n\n    // ---- 1. Which pairs draw random numbers (same test as the sequential code) ----\n    const size_t flagStride = (N + 31) / 32;\n    const size_t supStride = (N + 1023) / 1024;\n    std::vector<uint32_t> flags(N * flagStride, 0);\n    std::vector<int> supPrefix(N * supStride, 0);\n    std::vector<uint64_t> rowBase(N + 1, 0);\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n        const Triangle& triI = state.triangles[i];\n        uint32_t* row = &flags[i * flagStride];\n        int count = 0;\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < N; ++j) {\n            if ((j & 1023) == 0) supPrefix[i * supStride + (j >> 10)] = count;\n            if (i == j) continue;\n            const Triangle& triJ = state.triangles[j];\n            // Cull triangles facing the same direction (no samples drawn)\n            if (triI.normal().dot(triJ.normal()) > 0.99f) continue;\n            row[j >> 5] |= 1u << (j & 31);\n            ++count;\n        }\n        rowBase[i + 1] = rowBase[i] + static_cast<uint64_t>(count);\n    }\n    const uint64_t totalRand = 4ull * NUM_RAYS * rowBase[N];\n    if (totalRand == 0) {\n        printf(\"  Progress: %zu/%zu triangles\\n\", N, N);\n        return;\n    }\n\n    uint32_t* d_flags = deviceUpload(flags);\n    int* d_supPrefix = deviceUpload(supPrefix);\n    uint64_t* d_rowBase = deviceUpload(rowBase);\n\n    // ---- 2. Sub-stream layout and jump polynomials ----\n    const uint64_t capped = std::min<uint64_t>(totalRand, mt::BUFFER_BUDGET);\n    const uint64_t blocksTotal = (capped + mt::N - 1) / mt::N;\n    const int S = static_cast<int>(std::min<uint64_t>(mt::MAX_STREAMS,\n                                   std::max<uint64_t>(1, blocksTotal / mt::MIN_BLOCKS_PER_STREAM)));\n    const int blocksPerStream = static_cast<int>((blocksTotal + S - 1) / S);\n    const uint64_t L = static_cast<uint64_t>(blocksPerStream) * mt::N;   // outputs per sub-stream\n    const uint64_t W = L * static_cast<uint64_t>(S);                      // outputs per generation window\n    int levels = 0;\n    while ((1 << levels) < S) ++levels;\n\n    int D = 0;\n    mt::GF2Poly q = mt::transitionPolynomial(D);\n    if (D > mt::POLY_WORDS * 32) {\n        fprintf(stderr, \"Unexpected MT19937 polynomial degree %d\\n\", D);\n        exit(1);\n    }\n    mt::JumpPolyCalc calc(q, D);\n    std::vector<uint32_t> hPolys(static_cast<size_t>(std::max(levels, 1)) * mt::POLY_WORDS, 0);\n    {\n        mt::GF2Poly g = calc.powx(L);   // x^L mod q\n        for (int lv = 0; lv < levels; ++lv) {\n            for (int w = 0; w < mt::POLY_WORDS; ++w) {\n                const uint64_t word = g.w[w >> 1];\n                hPolys[static_cast<size_t>(lv) * mt::POLY_WORDS + w] = static_cast<uint32_t>((w & 1) ?
